title: Proposal to Review Public Sector’s Procurement Frameworks for Service Contracts to Support Sustainable Wage and Productivity Investments
what_it_is: Proposal to Review Public Sector’s Procurement Frameworks for Service Contracts to Support Sustainable Wage and Productivity Investments

sections.label: Government procurement evaluation criteria
sections.summary: Government procurement combines price and quality, requires Progressive Wage Mark certification in some sectors, and uses outcome-based contracts and per-year pricing for multi-year contracts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government uses a comprehensive set of criteria, combining price and quality considerations in procurement evaluations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For some sectors, eligible Government suppliers must have the Progressive Wage Mark (PWM) certification.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Central guidance has been provided to all Government procuring entities to adopt outcome-based contracts where appropriate and feasible, and to consider the adoption of more productive technology.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Finance (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For multi-year contracts, tenderers are typically able to submit prices for each contract year, rather than a single fixed price over the entire duration.

sections.label: Progressive Wage Mark contract requirements
sections.summary: Eligible contractors must obtain and maintain the Progressive Wage Mark, notify authorities of status changes, and may face contract termination for non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Contractors who are PW Mark eligible are required to obtain and maintain the PW Mark throughout the contract period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: They are also required to notify the contracting authorities if there are any changes to their PW Mark status.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For Government agencies, we reserve the right to take necessary action if contractors fail to comply with the requirements, including the right to terminate the contract.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Where there are further updates to the PW Mark requirements, the Ministry of Finance will review our guidance to agencies accordingly, where necessary.
